## `scripts/fp/reporter/health_dot.gd`

extends `Control`

A small health light (the league's mayor cell and its services page): a drawn shape, not text, coloured by ModelLedger health, with the sentence for it as its tooltip. The ledger's health word travels in `health`, so a test can read what a row shows.

- `COLORS = { "green": S.GOOD, "amber": S.AMBER, "red": S.RED, "grey": S.TEXT_FAINT, "scripted": S....`

### Functions

- `func set_health(p_health: String) -> void`

## `scripts/fp/reporter/league_ledger.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

What the model ledger (scripts/ai/model_ledger.gd) adds to the street's mayors' league: an "Orders" column (the share of a mayor's orders the city carried out), a "Speed" column (the typical time to answer, or what to read instead when no live answer has come) and a health light beside the name. Pure functions over standings rows; nothing here draws or reads the sim. Street text names no model here: the words are "Orders", "Speed" and the light's words. (The league's cells show a model only as a badge, hud_style.badge: the one street text allowed to.)

### Constants

- `HEALTH_WORDS = { "green": ["good", "Answering live."], "amber": ["shaky", "Answering live, but a recen...`: The words the light is read as (also its tooltip): ledger health -> [short word, sentence].
- `NO_DATA = "no data"`: What the Orders cell reads before any order was counted, and its tooltip.
- `NO_DATA_TIP = ("No orders counted yet. The count starts with the first turn after this city was begun...`

### Functions

- `static func decorate(rows: Array[Dictionary], ledger: ModelLedger) -> void`: Adds to each standings row (ReporterDesk.standings) "speed" (text), "speed_ms" (-1 when none), "health" (ModelLedger.health_of word) and "orders_text". ledger null, or the model_ledger flag off, leaves the neutral values: Speed "-", the light idle, and Orders the sim's whole-city count (a ledger an older save carried must not show through a switched-off flag). With the ledger on, Orders reads the same counters as the Arena tab (the ledger's: the model's own live and replayed orders, since the ledger began).
- `static func orders_text(done: int, refused: int) -> String`: "87%" for orders carried out of orders given; NO_DATA before any order.
- `static func speed_text(ledger_row: Dictionary) -> String`: A mayor's Speed: the median time to answer of its live calls ("11.2 s"); "replay" when its turns were recorded answers; "-" for nothing to say (no turn yet, or only the scripted planner).
- `static func health_word(health: String) -> String`: The word a health light is read as ("good", "shaky", "down", "replay", "scripted", "idle").
- `static func health_tip(health: String) -> String`: The light's tooltip: its sentence.

## `scripts/fp/reporter/league_minds.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The league's second page, "Services & minds": the minds that work for the city outside the mayors' chairs (the Gazette, the Council Speaker, the Chaos Director, the Grid Operator, Citizen Voices, the Street Inspector, the residents' minds and the chat voices), one row per model with what it has been asked to do, how many calls, how many answered live, failed, came from a recording or were answered by the scripted planner, the typical time to answer and a health light. Rows are ModelLedger.services(). Street text here names people and jobs only ("GridFall Gazette", "Residents", "Chat", the column words); the model a row belongs to appears only as its badge (hud_style.badge, meta BADGE_META: the one street text allowed to name a model, as on the mayors' table). fp_league_ledger_test asserts that every label holding a model's name is a badge.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `LG = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/league_ledger.gd")`
- `DOT = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/health_dot.gd")`
- `COLS = [ ["Service", 404, false], ["Calls", 56, true], ["Live", 52, true], ["Failed", 58, true...`: [heading, width px, right-aligned]: 8 px gaps between, filling the league panel's inner width (ReporterLeague.WIDTH less its margins).
- `TINT = Color("#9DB4FF")`
- `EMPTY = "Nothing has been asked of these minds yet."`

### Functions

- `static func fill(grid: GridContainer, rows: Array[Dictionary]) -> void`: Fills grid (columns = COLS.size()) with a heading row and one row per entry of rows (ModelLedger.services()).
- `static func line(r: Dictionary) -> String`: A row as text, the way table_lines() reads the mayors' table: "Gazette 4 · Chat 9 · 13 · ...".
- `static func scripted(r: Dictionary) -> int`: Calls answered by the scripted planner or heuristics (a failed live call, or no key): with Live, Failed and Replay it makes a row add up to its Calls.

## `scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_card.gd`

extends `Control`

The Gazette card on the HUD (feature "reporter"), bottom right above the district caption: the newest lead and the key to take it, or the story on assignment: what happened, where and how far, the scoop clock, the quote so far and what the story still needs (the scene, a quote, a photo), with the key to file it. The feature fills it through show_state(); nothing here reads the sim.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WIDTH = 320.0`
- `INNER = WIDTH - 27.0`: Text width inside the card: WIDTH less the 12 px side margins and the 3 px stripe.
- `SAFE = 24.0`
- `FROM_BOTTOM = SAFE + 104.0`: The bottom edge, clear of the district caption (90 px tall over the bottom safe margin).
- `BG = Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.07, 0.78)`
- `TICK = 9.0`

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func show_state(st: Dictionary) -> void`: st: {"kicker" ("New lead", "On assignment", "Ready to file"), "rank" ("Stringer · 120"), "color" (the deciding agent's), "headline", "where" ("214 Maple Street · 240 m · scoop 4:10"), "quote" ("" for none), "steps" ([text, done] pairs; none for a lead), "hint" (what K does now; "" hides the key)}.
- `func card_text() -> String`: Everything the card says now, " · " between the parts (the step rows read "[x] At the scene").

## `scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_desk.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The Gazette's desk (feature "reporter"): which AI decisions make a lead and how they read ("Viktor Han ordered a Police Station"), what a filed story says and earns, the press ranks, what a photo must frame, and the mayors' league (people, jobs, approval and funds, worth 25 points each). No nodes.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `FILED = 100`: Points for a filed story, and the bonuses on top: a scoop (filed fast), a local voice (the quote comes from someone who lives in the deciding mayor's district) and a sharp shot (a photo that frames the scene).
- `SCOOP = 50`
- `LOCAL = 25`
- `SHARP = 25`
- `RANKS = [ [0, "Stringer"], [300, "Reporter"], [1000, "Senior reporter"], [2500, "Star reporter"] ]`: Press ranks, [points needed, name], lowest first.
- `ZONED = {"R": "zoned new homes", "C": "zoned new shops", "I": "zoned new industry"}`
- `VAGUE = "made a decision here"`
- `QUOTE_CHARS = 140`: Longest quote kept, in characters.
- `CATEGORY = 25.0`: A league category is worth this many points to the best mayor in it (approval: a 10 out of 10).
- `FRAME = 0.65`: A shot frames its subject when the subject sits inside this central part of the view (a fraction of its width and of its height).

### Functions

- `static func mayor_lead(mi: int, entry: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: The lead in a mayor's turn: what they did at its focus tile, the first order carried out that has a place. {} when the turn has none. A lead is {"agent" ("0".."4", "council" or "chaos"), "headline", "tile": Vector2i, "district" (the deciding mayor; -1 for the others)}.
- `static func council_lead(r: Dictionary, hall: Vector2i) -> Dictionary`: The lead in a council ruling that passed or repealed an ordinance, at City Hall (hall); {} when the council changed nothing.
- `static func chaos_lead(d: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: The lead in a Chaos Director pick that struck somewhere ("Building Fire reported"); {} for a calm day or a pick without a place.
- `static func deed(a: Dictionary) -> String`: What one order did, as the Gazette puts it ("ordered a Police Station", "zoned new homes").
- `static func color_of(agent: String) -> Color`: The agent's colour (a mayor's or a support agent's).
- `static func clip(t: String) -> String`: A reply as a quote: de-branded, on one line, at most QUOTE_CHARS (cut at a word, with "…").
- `static func passerby(speaker: String) -> String`: The byline of a passer-by who answered "Ask someone here": a role reads "a shopkeeper" or "an officer", a name ("Mara Ellis") stays as it is, and nobody reads "someone nearby".
- `static func story_text(s: Dictionary) -> String`: The story as the Gazette runs it in the chat: "From 214 Maple Street: Viktor Han ordered a Police Station. “About time,” says Ana Ruiz."
- `static func points_for(scoop: bool, local: bool, sharp: bool) -> int`: Points for a story: FILED, and SCOOP, LOCAL and SHARP for each bonus it earned.
- `static func bonus_words(s: Dictionary) -> String`: The bonuses a story earned, in words ("scoop, local voice"); "" for none.
- `static func rank_of(points: int) -> Dictionary`: The press rank for points: {"name", "next" (the points the next rank needs, -1 at the top)}.
- `static func framed(p: Vector2, view: Vector2) -> bool`: Whether screen point p (a camera's unproject_position) lies in the central FRAME of a view of this size.
- `static func standings(sim: CitySim, people: Residents) -> Array[Dictionary]`: The league table, best first: a row per mayor {"mi", "who", "model", "style", "district", "color", "pop", "jobs", "approval" (0-10: what the district's residents think of their mayor, else its happiness), "funds", "orders" (carried out), "refused", "score" (0-100)}. People, jobs and funds score against the best mayor, approval out of 10. Ties go to the bigger district.

## `scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

The Gazette's stringer (integration feature "reporter"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Reporter). An AI decision with a place is a lead (ReporterDesk): a mayor's order, a council ruling, a Chaos Director strike. K takes the newest on assignment and sets a waypoint to the scene. There the story needs a quote: a reply someone gives the hero face to face, or the answer to "Ask someone here" (bus.talk_replied). It may also carry a photo: in photo mode (P) a click with the scene inside the viewfinder's marks is a sharp shot. K files it: the Gazette runs it in the chat (bus.story_filed) and it earns points towards the press ranks, more for a scoop (filed within a third of a day), a local voice (someone who lives in the district) and a sharp shot. L opens the mayors' league: the five mayors ranked, the press card, the open leads (chase another) and the latest stories. A lead goes cold after a day.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `DESK = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_desk.gd")`
- `CARD = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_card.gd")`
- `FINDER = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_viewfinder.gd")`
- `LEAGUE = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_league.gd")`
- `LEDGER = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/league_ledger.gd")`
- `MODAL = &"league"`
- `INPUTS = ["press_story", "press_league"]`
- `MAX_LEADS = 4`
- `KEEP_STORIES = 5`
- `LEAD_DAYS = 1.0`: A lead goes cold LEAD_DAYS after it happened; a story filed within SCOOP_DAYS is a scoop (sim days).
- `SCOOP_DAYS = 1.0 / 3.0`
- `SCENE = 3.0`: The scene: within SCENE tiles of the lead's tile. A press photo holds a point SUBJECT_Y above the tile's ground, from within PHOTO_RANGE (u).
- `SUBJECT_Y = 0.15`
- `PHOTO_RANGE = 4.0`
- `QUOTE_MIN = 12`: A reply shorter than this is no quote ("Hm.").
- `REFRESH = 0.5`
- `HALL_AT = Vector2i(15, 14)`: Where a council ruling happens when the city has no City Hall.
- `NO_POINT = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`
- `PHOTO_FRAMES = 8`: Photo tour: frames to wait for the tour's teleport before staging, and the staged answer.
- `PHOTO_SPEAKER = "Shopkeeper"`
- `PHOTO_QUOTE = "Nobody asked us first, but honestly, it's about time."`

### Properties

- `leads: Array[Dictionary]`: Open leads, newest first: ReporterDesk leads with "at" (sim days) and "place".
- `story: Dictionary`: The lead on assignment with its "quote", "by", "quote_id" (the resident's id, "" for a passer-by), "local", "sharp", "seen" (the hero reached the scene) and "wp" (the waypoint set for it); {} for none.
- `stories: Array[Dictionary]`: The latest filed stories, newest first: {"text", "points", "bonus", "day"}.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`: Boot, load or New City: the old city's leads and story are gone.
- `func to_dict() -> Dictionary`
- `func from_dict(d: Dictionary) -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
- `func take_lead(k: int = 0) -> bool`: Takes open lead k (0: the newest) on assignment, dropping any story already on it, and sets a waypoint to its scene. False when there is no such lead.
- `func press_story() -> void`: K: takes the newest lead, or files the story on assignment once it has its quote (else says what it still needs).
- `func file_story() -> Dictionary`: Files the story on assignment once it has its quote: points towards the press ranks, the Gazette's chat line (bus.story_filed) and a memory for the resident quoted. Returns the story as filed (bus.story_filed's dict), {} when there is nothing to file.
- `func at_scene() -> bool`: True while the hero is at the scene of the story on assignment (in photo mode: stood there when the camera came up).
- `func scene_framed() -> bool`: True when the camera holds the scene of the story on assignment inside the viewfinder's marks (ReporterDesk.framed), from within PHOTO_RANGE.
- `func snap() -> bool`: The shutter (a click in photo mode on an assignment): a sharp shot when the hero stands at the scene and the camera holds it inside the marks. True for a sharp shot.
- `func open_league() -> bool`: Opens the mayors' league (L). False when it may not open now: no HUD, a modal open, paused, in photo mode or talking.
- `func close_league() -> void`
- `func photo_shots() -> Array`: Three shots of a lead: its scene with the card on assignment, the press camera there with a sharp shot taken, and the league over the street at the spawn once the story is filed.

## `scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_league.gd`

extends `Control`

The mayors' league (feature "reporter", L): the five AI mayors ranked on people, jobs, approval and funds (25 points each, ReporterDesk.standings), each with the badge of the model they run on, then the player's press card (rank, points, stories filed), the story on assignment, the open leads with a button to chase one, and the latest stories. The feature fills it through show_league(); nothing here reads the sim.

### Signals

- `chase_requested(lead: int)`: The Chase button of open lead k (0: the newest) was pressed.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `LG = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/league_ledger.gd")`
- `MINDS = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/league_minds.gd")`
- `DOT = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/health_dot.gd")`
- `WIDTH = 960.0`
- `MARGIN = 20.0`: The panel's side margins (hud_style.panel) and the gap between two table cells.
- `GAP = 8.0`
- `COLS = [ ["#", 26, false], ["Mayor", 220, false], ["District", 168, false], ["People", 58, tru...`: Table columns: [heading, width px, right-aligned]. With the 8 px gaps they fill the panel's inner width (WIDTH less its 20 px margins; Orders and Speed come from the model ledger). District holds the longest district name whole (165 px at 14 px: fp_league_ledger_test measures it) and Mayor the longest name with its model's badge and the light (207 px).
- `LISTED_STORIES = 3`
- `TITLES = ["Mayors' league", "Services & minds"]`
- `MINDS_NOTE = "Who answers for the city besides the mayors: calls so far and how they went"`: The second page's one-line note, under its title.

### Properties

- `page: int`: 0: the mayors' table and the press card; 1: Services & minds (Tab flips).

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func show_league(rows: Array[Dictionary], desk: Dictionary) -> void`: rows: ReporterDesk.standings(), best first. desk: {"day" ("Day 6 · 14:20"), "press" (the player's rank and points), "assignment" (the story's headline, "" for none), "leads" (open leads' lines, newest first), "stories" ({"text", "points", "bonus"}, newest first)}.
- `func show_minds(rows: Array[Dictionary]) -> void`: Rows of the Services & minds page: ModelLedger.services().
- `func flip_page() -> void`: Tab: the other page (the mayors' table, Services & minds).
- `func set_page(k: int) -> void`
- `static func is_flip(event: InputEvent) -> bool`: True for the key that flips the page (Tab, pressed, not an echo).
- `func minds_lines() -> PackedStringArray`: The Services & minds rows as text, one per model (see league_minds.gd line()).
- `func health_dots() -> PackedStringArray`: The health word each mayor's light shows, in table order.
- `func table_lines() -> PackedStringArray`: The table's rows as text, one line per mayor ("1 · Viktor Han · Harbor Heights · ... · 78").
- `func chase_buttons() -> Array[Button]`: The Chase buttons, newest lead first.

## `scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_viewfinder.gd`

extends `Control`

The press camera's viewfinder (feature "reporter"), over the view in photo mode while a story is on assignment: corner marks round the middle of the view a press photo must hold the scene in (ReporterDesk.FRAME), green while it does, the story above the marks and what to do below them, the last shot's result under that, and a white flash for the shutter. The feature drives it through show_state(), note() and flash().

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `DESK = preload("res://scripts/fp/reporter/reporter_desk.gd")`
- `ARM = 36.0`: Corner mark arm length and line width, and the centre cross (px).
- `LINE = 3.0`
- `CROSS = 8.0`
- `FLASH_S = 0.3`: How long the shutter flash and a shot's note last (s).
- `NOTE_S = 2.5`
- `IDLE = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8)`
- `MISS = Color("#FFB547")`

### Properties

- `framed: bool`: The scene sits inside the marks now.

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func show_state(title: String, hint: String, in_frame: bool) -> void`: title: the story; hint: what to do now; in_frame: the scene sits inside the marks.
- `func note(t: String, sharp: bool) -> void`: Shows the result of a shot under the hint for NOTE_S seconds (green for a sharp one).
- `func note_text() -> String`: The shot's result while it shows, else "".
- `func hint_text() -> String`: The hint line ("Click to take the shot").
- `func flash() -> void`: The shutter: the view flashes white and fades over FLASH_S.
